title: db.IsAway treats any net.Error as Postgres being away, so job.run marks non-database network errors as cancelled, not failed
notes: IsAway returns true for any net.Error, including S3 or segment-store timeouts. worker.run now adds `|| db.IsAway(err)` to the cancelled branch, so a store outage that returns a net error ends the job as `cancelled`. Such jobs are never refused, and viewers restart them without limit instead of seeing the last-attempt-failed protection. The same IsAway test would also start an outage tracker and pr
